resources.string: Clocks keep time by themselves and follow your phone\'s 12 or 24-hour setting. Tap a clock to open your alarms.
A digital clock can show another time zone with a label, for a world clock. Change it under %1$s on the WidgetsPlus home screen.
Time and date, in your time zone or another city\'s
A clock face in your phone\'s colours
Follows your phone, also when you travel
Shown above the time, for example \"Home\" or \"Office\". Other time zones show the city name if you leave this empty.
No time zone found. Try a nearby large city.
